card.name: Inside brand names starting with X
card.fires_on: The second piece of a brand drug name that begins with X, such as XADAGO, XIFAXAN or XOSPATA, right after the X. It appears in label text that refers to the drug by name.

modes.label: XADAGO
modes.description: The AD piece after X in the brand name XADAGO in safety and dosing text.
modes.example: There is no human experience with X<<AD>>AGO overdose.

modes.label: Other X brands
modes.description: The middle piece of other X-initial brand names such as XIFAXAN or XOSPATA.
